_readme: Tests skipped by tools/run_all_tests.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; remove it once fixed or deleted. PRs also skip the slow lists; nightly runs the slow lists (--with-slow) but still honours the quarantine, so it only goes red on new breakage. --all ignores this file for a manual full audit. A key with :: deselects one test.
